hadi-march/ui#useLayout.doc: The Layout around this code, or null.
hadi-march/ui#useLayout.tr: Bu kodu saran Layout'un API'si, yoksa null.

hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.name: UserMenu
hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.doc: Account button with a menu: `<UserMenu name="Ada" detail="ada@x.com" items={[profile, "-", signOut]} />`

props.name: compact
props.doc: Only the avatar (narrow places such as an icon rail or a top bar).

hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.tr: Menülü hesap düğmesi: `<UserMenu name="Ada" detail="ada@x.com" items={[profile, "-", signOut]} />`

hadi-march/ui#validateJson.name: validateJson
hadi-march/ui#validateJson.doc: Check `value` against `schema`; every problem with its path.
hadi-march/ui#validateJson.signature: function validateJson(value: unknown, schema: JsonSchema | undefined, path: JsonPath = []): JsonError[]
hadi-march/ui#validateJson.tr: `value` değerini `schema` şemasına karşı denetler; her sorunu yoluyla birlikte döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.name: validateRecords
hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.doc: First problem in a list of records, or null.
hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.signature: function validateRecords(list: readonly (Values | null | undefined)[] | null | undefined, fields: RecordFields | null | undefined): string | null
hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.tr: Kayıt listesindeki ilk sorunu döndürür, yoksa null.

hadi-march/ui#VerifiedMark.name: VerifiedMark

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Verified"); `false`: decorative (the text beside it says it).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Own icon (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour token (default: the brand blue).

props.name: size
props.doc: sm (beside body text, default) · md (beside a heading) · lg.

hadi-march/ui#VerifiedMark.tr: Adın yanındaki doğrulanmış hesap rozeti (erişilebilir adıyla bir resim); ikonu, metni, rengi ve boyutu değiştirilebilir: `<VerifiedMark size="md" />`.

hadi-march/ui#Widget.name: Widget
hadi-march/ui#Widget.doc: Draw a widget point: `<Widget sources={[codeView]} input={{ source, lang: "tsx" }} />`. The input is live: when it changes (`input={{ source: $code }}`), the provider draws again for the new input.
hadi-march/ui#Widget.tr: Bir widget noktası çizer: `<Widget sources={[codeView]} input={{ source, lang: "tsx" }} />`.

hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.name: widgetPoint
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.doc: Create (or get, by id) a widget point. `defaults` are always present and lose ties to later providers.
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.signature:
function widgetPoint

(id: string, opts?: { defaults?: readonly WidgetProvider

[] }): WidgetPoint
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.tr: Bir widget noktası oluşturur (veya kimliğiyle getirir). `defaults` her zaman bulunur ve sonraki sağlayıcılarla eşitlikte kaybeder.

hadi-march/ui#Window.name: Window
hadi-march/ui#Window.doc: A window in its area: move, resize, dock to an edge, minimize, fill, close; Windows, Mac or HADİ look.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon node before the title.

props.name: chrome
props.doc: Look of the frame (default "hadi").

props.name: x
props.doc: Start place and size in px (default: 32 × 20 rem, centered).

props.name: state
props.doc: Start state, or a live one with onStateChange.

props.name: open
props.doc: Shown while true (live); without it the close button removes the window until it is rendered again.

props.name: minimizable
props.doc: Buttons to show (default all three).

props.name: movable
props.doc: false: fixed in place (the buttons still work).

props.name: snap
props.doc: Dock when dragged to an edge (default true).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep place, size and state in localStorage under "m.win.<persist>".

props.name: labels
props.type: { close?: string; minimize?: string; restore?: string; maximize?: string; move?: string; moveHint?: string } | undefined
props.doc: Texts of the buttons and the title bar (the defaults are translated).

props.name: icons
props.type: { close?: unknown; minimize?: unknown; maximize?: unknown; restore?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Your own button icons: an icon, a text or a node each.

props.name: color
props.doc: Accent of the frame: the title icon, the button hover and the dock preview (default: the accent).

props.name: stripe
props.doc: The brand stripe of the "hadi" look (default true).

props.name: animated
props.doc: false: place and size change at once, without a transition (default true).

hadi-march/ui#Window.tr: Alanı içinde taşınır, boyutlanır pencere: kenara kenetlenir, küçülür, alanı kaplar, kapanır; HADİ, Mac ya da Windows görünümü.

hadi-march/ui#Wizard.name: Wizard
hadi-march/ui#Wizard.doc: Props: steps [{ title, description, fields?: [names], schema?: schema(), validate?(values) → {name: msg} | string | null, render?(form) → node }], schema (optional when every step has its own), initial, onSubmit(values), submitLabel, layout, cols, onStep(index), form (an existing useForm).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: schema
props.doc: Optional when every step has its own schema.

props.name: form
props.doc: An existing useForm() controller.

props.name: stepper
props.doc: The stage list on top (Steps): default true.

props.name: progress
props.doc: The progress bar under the stage list: default true.

props.name: count
props.doc: The "Step 2 of 3" text beside the buttons: default true.

props.name: backButton
props.doc: The Back button: default true.

props.name: labels
props.type: { back?: unknown; next?: unknown; step?: ((index: number) => string) | undefined; count?: ((index: number, total: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: the buttons, the title of a step without one, and the "Step 2 of 3" text (index is 0-based).

hadi-march/ui#Wizard.tr: Prop'lar: steps [{ title, description, fields?: [names], schema?: schema(), validate?(values) → {name: msg} | string | null, render?(form) → node }], schema (her adımın kendi şeması varsa isteğe bağlı), initial ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/table#CellEditor.name: CellEditor
hadi-march/table#CellEditor.doc: Inline cell editor for a table's current edit (`table.editing()`): the form control of the column type (text, number, date, select, checkbox), Enter saves, Escape cancels, the validation message under it. Shared by <Table> and DataGrid. `onKey` runs first; call `e.preventDefault()` there to replace the default handling of a key (DataGrid: Tab saves and moves on).
hadi-march/table#CellEditor.signature: function CellEditor<R>(table: TableState<R>, col: TableColumn<R>, row: R, idBase: string, onKey?: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void): Element

props.name: format
props.type: (row: R, col: TableColumn<R> | Column<R> | string) => unknown

props.name: moveColumn
props.doc: Move among visible columns by `delta` positions (hidden columns are skipped).

props.name: runBulk
props.doc: Run a bulk action with the selected rows; clears the selection when it ran successfully. Errors are swallowed (the action reports them).

hadi-march/table#CellEditor.tr: Tablonun geçerli düzenlemesi (`table.editing()`) için satır içi hücre düzenleyici: sütun türüne göre input / select / checkbox; Enter kaydeder, Escape iptal eder, doğrulama iletisi altında görünür. <Table> ve DataGrid tarafından ortak kullanılır.

hadi-march/table#createTable.name: createTable
hadi-march/table#createTable.doc: Headless table. Options: rows | source, columns | schema, rowKey ("id"), pageSize (25), pageSizes, paging (true | false | "cursor"), paramNames, sort, filters, search, storageKey, urlKey, urlDelay, virtual (true | "auto"), virtualThreshold, onEdit, exportAll, filename, queryKey, loading, error.
hadi-march/table#createTable.tr: Başsız (headless) tablo. Seçenekler: rows | source, columns | schema, rowKey ("id"), pageSize (25), pageSizes, paging (true | false | "cursor"), paramNames, sort, filters, search, storageKey, urlKey, urlDelay, virtual ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/table#createVirtual.name: createVirtual
hadi-march/table#createVirtual.doc: Reactive window over `count()` rows. Call `onScroll(el)` from the scroll container's "scroll" event.
hadi-march/table#createVirtual.tr: `count()` satır üzerinde tepkisel pencere. Kaydırma kapsayıcısının "scroll" olayından `onScroll(el)` çağrılır.

hadi-march/table#csvField.name: csvField
hadi-march/table#csvField.doc: Quote one CSV field (RFC 4180). With `safe`, text starting with = + - @ is prefixed so spreadsheets do not run it.
hadi-march/table#csvField.signature: function csvField(v: unknown, separator: string = ",", safe: boolean = true): string
hadi-march/table#csvField.tr: Tek bir CSV alanını tırnaklar (RFC 4180). `safe` ile, = + - @ ile başlayan metnin önüne ek eklenir; tablo programları onu çalıştırmaz.

hadi-march/table#describeFilter.name: describeFilter
hadi-march/table#describeFilter.doc: Human text for a filter chip.
hadi-march/table#describeFilter.signature: function describeFilter(col: { filter?: Column["filter"] | undefined; options?: OptionsInput | undefined }, f: unknown): string

params.name: col
params.type: { filter?: Column["filter"] | undefined; options?: OptionsInput | undefined }

hadi-march/table#download.name: download
hadi-march/table#download.doc: Save text as a file through a temporary object URL.
hadi-march/table#download.signature: function download(filename: string, text: string, type: string = "text/plain;charset=utf-8"): string
hadi-march/table#download.tr: Metni geçici bir nesne URL'si üzerinden dosya olarak kaydeder.

hadi-march/table#FilterControl.name: FilterControl
hadi-march/table#FilterControl.signature: function FilterControl<R>(table: TableState<R>, col: TableColumn<R>): Element

props.name: format
props.type: (row: R, col: TableColumn<R> | Column<R> | string) => unknown

props.name: moveColumn
props.doc: Move among visible columns by `delta` positions (hidden columns are skipped).

props.name: runBulk
props.doc: Run a bulk action with the selected rows; clears the selection when it ran successfully. Errors are swallowed (the action reports them).

hadi-march/table#formatValue.name: formatValue
hadi-march/table#formatValue.doc: Display text of a cell: `format` (fn | pipe name | [pipe, ...args]), option labels, Yes/No, lists.
hadi-march/table#formatValue.signature: function formatValue<R>(row: R, col: Column<R>): unknown
hadi-march/table#formatValue.tr: Hücrenin görüntü metni: `format` (işlev | boru adı | [boru, ...args]), seçenek etiketleri, Evet/Hayır, listeler.

hadi-march/table#isEmptyFilter.name: isEmptyFilter
hadi-march/table#isEmptyFilter.doc: True when a filter value means "no filter".
hadi-march/table#isEmptyFilter.tr: Filtre değeri "filtre yok" anlamına geliyorsa true.

hadi-march/table#mapParams.name: mapParams
hadi-march/table#mapParams.doc: Rename / drop / transform server params: `{ size: "limit", offset: "skip", page: null, sort: (s) => ({ order: … }) }`.
hadi-march/table#mapParams.signature: function mapParams(p: Record<string, unknown>, names?: ParamNames, cursorMode?: boolean): Record<string, unknown>
hadi-march/table#mapParams.tr: Sunucu parametrelerini yeniden adlandırır / çıkarır / dönüştürür: `{ size: "limit", offset: "skip", page: null, sort: (s) => ({ order: … }) }`.

hadi-march/table#matchFilter.name: matchFilter
hadi-march/table#matchFilter.doc: Does `row` pass the filter `f` on column `col`? (One row; for many rows use filterFn(col, f) once.)
hadi-march/table#matchFilter.signature: function matchFilter<R>(row: R, col: Column<R>, f: unknown): boolean

hadi-march/table#sortRows.name: sortRows
hadi-march/table#sortRows.doc: Stable multi-column sort. Nulls always last. `sort` = [{ key, dir }].
hadi-march/table#sortRows.signature: function sortRows<R>(rows: readonly R[], sort: readonly SortSpec[], columns: readonly Column<R>[], locale?: string): readonly R[]
hadi-march/table#sortRows.tr: Kararlı çok sütunlu sıralama. Null değerler hep sonda. `sort` = [{ key, dir }].

hadi-march/table#Table.name: Table
hadi-march/table#Table.doc: Data table. Accepts every createTable() option (or a ready `table`), plus: selectable, bulkActions, rowActions, rowActionsInline, onRowClick, expand, empty, caption, layout ("auto"|"table"|"cards"), cardBreakpoint, height, rowHeight, overscan, pageSizes, toolbar, exportable, searchDelay, rowClass, resizable, reorderable.

props.name: rowActionsInline
props.doc: Inline buttons instead of a kebab menu (default: up to 2 actions inline).

props.name: source
props.type: ((params: TableParams, ctx: { signal: AbortSignal }) => Promise<TablePage<R> | R[]>) | undefined
props.doc: Server mode: one page for the (mapped) params. A plain array is a page without total.

props.name: search
props.doc: Initial search text; `false` hides the search box (<Table>).

props.name: onEdit
props.type: ((row: R, key: string, value: unknown) => unknown) | undefined

props.name: exportAll
props.type: ((params: TableQuery) => Promise<readonly R[]> | readonly R[]) | undefined

hadi-march/table#Table.tr: Veri tablosu. Her createTable() seçeneğini (veya hazır bir `table`) kabul eder; ayrıca: selectable, bulkActions, rowActions, rowActionsInline, onRowClick, expand, empty, caption, layout ("auto"|"table"|"cards"), cardBreakpoint ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/table#toCSV.name: toCSV
hadi-march/table#toCSV.doc: Rows to CSV text with the table's columns (formula-safe, optional BOM, formatted or raw values).
hadi-march/table#toCSV.signature: function toCSV<R>(rows: readonly R[], columns: readonly Column<R>[], opts: CSVOptions<R> = {}): string
hadi-march/table#toCSV.tr: Satırları tablonun sütunlarıyla CSV metnine çevirir (formül güvenli, isteğe bağlı BOM, biçimlendirilmiş veya ham değerler).

hadi-march/table#toJSON.name: toJSON
hadi-march/table#toJSON.doc: JSON array of objects keyed by column key (raw values unless `formatted`).
hadi-march/table#toJSON.signature: function toJSON<R>(rows: readonly R[], columns: readonly Column<R>[], opts: JSONOptions<R> = {}): string
hadi-march/table#toJSON.tr: Sütun anahtarıyla anahtarlanmış nesnelerden oluşan JSON dizisi (`formatted` verilmedikçe ham değerler).

hadi-march/table#windowRange.name: windowRange
hadi-march/table#windowRange.doc: Rows [start, end) to render and the spacer heights above/below them.
hadi-march/table#windowRange.tr: Çizilecek [start, end) satırları ve üstlerindeki/altlarındaki boşluk yükseklikleri.

hadi-march/charts#arcPath.name: arcPath
hadi-march/charts#arcPath.doc: SVG path for an annular sector (r0 = 0 for a pie slice).
hadi-march/charts#arcPath.signature: function arcPath(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, r0: number, a0: number, a1: number): string
hadi-march/charts#arcPath.tr: Halka diliminin SVG yolu (pasta dilimi için r0 = 0).

hadi-march/charts#AreaChart.name: AreaChart
hadi-march/charts#AreaChart.doc: Area chart (`stacked` stacks the visible series).
hadi-march/charts#AreaChart.tr: Alan grafiği (`stacked` görünür serileri üst üste yığar).

hadi-march/charts#BarChart.name: BarChart
hadi-march/charts#BarChart.doc: Bar chart. See docs/charts.md for props.
hadi-march/charts#BarChart.tr: Çubuk grafiği. Prop'lar için docs/charts.md dosyasına bakın.

hadi-march/charts#BarList.name: BarList
hadi-march/charts#BarList.doc: Ranked horizontal bars with labels ("top N" lists). Rows are buttons when `onSelect` is set.
hadi-march/charts#BarList.tr: Etiketli, sıralı yatay çubuklar ("ilk N" listeleri). `onSelect` verilince satırlar düğme olur.

hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.name: heatLevel
hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.doc: Level 0 (empty / ≤ 0) … levels-1 for a value relative to `max`.
hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.signature: function heatLevel(v: number | null | undefined, max: number, levels: number = 5): number
hadi-march/charts#heatLevel.tr: `max` değerine göre bir değerin seviyesi: 0 (boş / ≤ 0) … levels-1.

hadi-march/charts#Heatmap.name: Heatmap
hadi-march/charts#Heatmap.tr: Isı haritası. Prop'lar için docs/charts.md dosyasına bakın.

hadi-march/charts#LineChart.name: LineChart
hadi-march/charts#LineChart.doc: Line chart. See docs/charts.md for props.
hadi-march/charts#LineChart.tr: Çizgi grafiği. Prop'lar için docs/charts.md dosyasına bakın.

hadi-march/charts#lttb.name: lttb
hadi-march/charts#lttb.doc: Downsample a series to `threshold` points and keep its visual shape (Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets).

hadi-march/charts#niceStep.doc: A "nice" step (1, 2, 5 × 10^n) that splits `span` into about `count` parts.

hadi-march/charts#niceStep.tr: `span` aralığını yaklaşık `count` parçaya bölen "düzgün" bir adım (1, 2, 5 × 10^n).

hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.name: niceTicks
hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.doc: Round a domain outwards to nice values. Returns `{ min, max, step, ticks }`.
hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.signature: function niceTicks(min: number, max: number, count: number = 5): NiceTicks
hadi-march/charts#niceTicks.tr: Bir tanım aralığını dışa doğru düzgün değerlere yuvarlar. `{ min, max, step, ticks }` döndürür.

hadi-march/charts#PieChart.name: PieChart
hadi-march/charts#PieChart.doc: Pie / donut chart. See docs/charts.md for props.
hadi-march/charts#PieChart.tr: Pasta / halka grafiği. Prop'lar için docs/charts.md dosyasına bakın.

hadi-march/charts#pieLayout.name: pieLayout

hadi-march/charts#pieLayout.signature: function pieLayout(values: readonly unknown[], __1: { padAngle?: number } = {}): PieSlice[]
hadi-march/charts#pieLayout.tr: Negatif olmayan değerler için açılar (radyan, saat 12'den saat yönünde). [{start, end, value, share}] döndürür.

props.doc: Several colors: "brand" (the four HADİ colors, the HADİ theme's default), a list of color tokens, or "single" (one color even in a multicolor theme).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

hadi-march/charts#ProgressRing.tr: 0–100 (veya 0–`max`) puan halkası. `thresholds` (varsayılan [50, 80]) ile `m-ring-low|mid|high` seviye sınıfı verilir.

hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.name: scaleBand
hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.doc: Band scale for categories. `s(v)` → band start; `s.bandwidth`; `s.step`; `s.center(v)`; `s.invert(px)` → nearest value.
hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.signature: function scaleBand<V>(domain: readonly V[] = [], range: Range = [0, 1], __2: { paddingInner?: number; paddingOuter?: number } = {}): BandScale<V>
hadi-march/charts#scaleBand.tr: Kategoriler için bant ölçeği. `s(v)` → bant başlangıcı; `s.bandwidth`; `s.step`; `s.center(v)`; `s.invert(px)` → en yakın değer.

hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.name: scaleLinear
hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.doc: Linear scale. `s(v)` → range value; `s.invert(px)`; `s.ticks(n)`; `s.nice(n)` → new scale on a nice domain.
hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.signature: function scaleLinear(domain: readonly [unknown, unknown] = [0, 1], range: Range = [0, 1]): LinearScale
hadi-march/charts#scaleLinear.tr: Doğrusal ölçek. `s(v)` → aralık değeri; `s.invert(px)`; `s.ticks(n)`; `s.nice(n)` → düzgün tanım aralığında yeni ölçek.

hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.name: scaleTime
hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.doc: Time scale over Dates or epoch ms. `s.invert(px)` returns a Date.
hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.signature: function scaleTime(domain: readonly [unknown, unknown], range: Range = [0, 1]): TimeScale
hadi-march/charts#scaleTime.tr: Date veya epoch ms üzerinde zaman ölçeği. `s.invert(px)` bir Date döndürür.

hadi-march/charts#Sparkline.name: Sparkline
hadi-march/charts#Sparkline.doc: Tiny trend line without axes. `data` = numbers or objects (`y` key/fn).
hadi-march/charts#Sparkline.tr: Eksensiz küçük eğilim çizgisi. `data` = sayılar veya nesneler (`y` anahtarı/işlevi).
